scope_note: All fixed amendment rows classified and reconciled for owned Temporal deltas or supplied engine/Intl contracts; conditional rows remain open.
limits: Mechanical extraction is not a normative-requirement count or semantic completeness proof.
Each prose/grammar/table block may contain multiple obligations; rows need manual decomposition during review.
Clause gates explicitly retain property-attribute, realm and dependency obligations not mechanically separable.
Nested step labels follow rendered ecmarkup numeric/alpha/roman cycle; counts cross-checked against all active algorithm list items.

Snapshot contains inserted/deleted amendment markup; deleted text excluded, inserted text included. Numbered paths retain published list positions, including gaps left by wholly deleted steps; these empty/deleted items are counted separately.
Unclassified text rows remain explicit review obligations, not silently dropped.
Snapshot is pinned Nov21; live TOC rechecked Nov22 separately, full-body future changes require regeneration.
status_note: Applicable owned/shared/runtime paths reviewed locally; existing_contract_reused is supplied Intl behavior, not full formatter internals signoff. Spec issues and conditional contracts remain explicit.
implementation_status_note: present records a source binding or helper correspondence, not verified behavior. mapping_unresolved never means implementation missing.
fix_status_note: not_reconciled preserves historical corrections and in-progress PRs for row-level import; it does not mean no defects or no fixes exist. Current fixes and validation remain in the linked audit ledger.

latest_reconciliation.scope: Temporal-specific deltas and actual JS/Intl contracts; no wholesale ECMA262/402 reimplementation or unsupported full formatter signoff.

status_definitions.verified_local_step: Local Temporal-specific requirement reviewed under stated callee contract.
status_definitions.verified: Local clause or supplied engine contract reviewed; no transitive whole-Intl claim.
status_definitions.existing_contract_reused: Unchanged named Intl/formatter contract supplied; actual Temporal delta reviewed separately.
status_definitions.conditional: Actual named unresolved bridge/provider/realm premise or source-only candidate.
status_definitions.not_applicable: Excluded relocation/editorial placeholder with recorded concrete reason.
status_definitions.spec_issue: Rendered comparison inconsistency, separate from implementation gaps.
